transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad, and it just doesn't seem to lift. This low mood has been going on for about two years now. I finally decided I needed to seek some help for it.

During these past two years, have you experienced any periods of at least two weeks where your symptoms were significantly more severe, or has your mood remained consistently low at roughly the same level throughout?

It has been consistently low and flat at pretty much the same level for the entire two years. I haven't had any sudden, severe dips or periods where it got much worse. It just feels like a continuous, chronic state of sadness and emptiness that never lifts.
During these two years, have you gone for more than two months at a time without feeling this way, or has the sadness been present almost every single day?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. The sadness has been there almost every single day for the entire two years. It just feels like a continuous, heavy cloud that never lifts, even for a few weeks.
Besides the low mood, have you also experienced other symptoms like changes in your appetite, trouble sleeping, low energy, low self-esteem, difficulty concentrating, or feelings of hopelessness?

I've really struggled to focus, and my mind constantly feels foggy and indecisive. My self-esteem is also terrible, and I often feel completely worthless and inferior to everyone else. I haven't really noticed any issues with my sleep, appetite, energy, or hopelessness, though.
Have you ever experienced a distinct period where your mood was unusually elevated, expansive, or irritable, accompanied by a decreased need for sleep or increased energy?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never had periods of high energy, elevated mood, or needing less sleep. It has just been a constant low.
